name: Umbrune Vessur
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Argued for experiment and mathematics against argument from authority.
text: Umbrune vessur of the lower flue, keeps a door for the 5th tranche, doors 39 to 47. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads Roger Bacon.
